content.value: Species A is evaporating from a flat surface into species B. Assume that the concentration profile for species A in the concentration boundary layer is of the form $C _ { A } ( y ) = D y ^ { 2 } + E y +$ F, where D, E and F are constants at any x-location and y- is measured along a normal from the surface. Develop an expression for the mass transfer convection coefficient $h _ { m }$ in terms of these constants, the concentration of A in the free stream $\mathcal { C } _ { A , \alpha }$ and the mass diffusivity $D _ { A B }$
